contexts.text: Man is born again through truths of faith. HH 342. [Swedenborg footnote 1.]
He ought to be born again as an infant.
Regeneration is called rebirth, but spiritual.
The man who is being born again...
The rebirth of the Sensual subject to the intellectual part, Treated of. AC 5122.

In order to be delivered from Hell, man must be wholly born again by the Lord. It is this rebirth which is called regeneration. In order therefore that he may be born again he must first learn truths...
Regeneration is rebirth as to the spiritual man. Described.
